## Daftar periksa

- [ ] `npx playwright test` lolos (atau berkas uji yang relevan, sebutkan)

- [ ] `node scripts/check-style.mjs` lolos (tanpa em dash dan ampersand di teks)

- [ ] Perubahan UI: screenshot di ukuran HP (minimal 568x320 dan 844x390) dan desktop dilampirkan
- [ ] Setiap commit memakai `Signed-off-by` (DCO, `git commit -s`)
